test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following line graph shows the export by company A and company B (in crores) over the five years 2010 to 2014. In which year, the difference between the export from company A and company B was maximum? (Currency is Indian rupees.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4d0d2c02509c1a2cea9a92144e00ec6c810e06d10d64a307dfacfaa5558f79f.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Here is the calculation of the difference for each year:

Year 2010: Difference = 150 - 100 = 50

Year 2011: Difference = = 120 - 80 = 40

Year 2012: Difference = 120 - 100 = 20

Year 2013: Difference = 200 - 150 = 50

Year 2014: Difference = 170 - 100 = 70

From the above calculations, we can see that the maximum difference occurs in

the year 2014, where the difference between the exports from Company A and

Company B was 70.

**Therefore, the year in which the difference between the exports from Company A and Company B was maximum is 2014.**
